text: The project integrates participatory governance with infrastructure and market systems support, establishing 150 new Water Management Cooperative Associations (WMCAs) and strengthening 230 existing ones. It includes climate- and disaster-resilient infrastructure investments, such as the modernization of the Bakkhali Rubber Dam, and agribusiness development to enhance market access and income stability. The project covers 42 districts, targeting over 220,000 hectares and benefiting approximately 380,000 households.

metadata.solution_name: Climate and Disaster Resilient Small-Scale Water Resources Management Project (CDRSSWRMP/SSWRM)
